title: Architecture Review
transcriptSegments: Let's settle the database question from last week. Postgres makes more sense than Mongo because our user data is relational.
Agreed. We will use Postgres for the user database and can add a document store later if needed.
Sarah will own the migration script and have it ready by Thursday before the staging deploy.
Read latency hit 800 milliseconds at p99 last month. We still need to learn whether connection pooling will help.
The new caching layer cut API response time by 40 percent.
The auth service is blocked because the OAuth provider has not sent sandbox credentials. Mike will follow up with the vendor this week.
We also agreed to move launch to the 15th so QA has more runway.
